parameter_semantics: No high-level numeric parameters. The caller passes an empty object. At each replan, the adapter resolves the newest observed hole_pose as the SE(3) reference; positions are world metres and observed quaternions are wxyz.
output_semantics: Each slot is an unnormalized Cartesian TCP target [p_hole(3 metres), R_hole_tcp first-two rotation-matrix columns(6), gripper(1)] relative to the newest causal hole_pose fixed for the sampled chunk. Slots denote t-1 through t+14 and the host executes slots 1 through 8. Decoding Gram-Schmidt projects the 6D orientation to SO(3), composes T_world_hole*T_hole_tcp, and calls panda_kinematics.solve_ik from freshly measured qpos. A deterministic orthogonal fallback is used only for a degenerate sampled 6D pair. The gripper scalar is passed through and the executor applies its declared binary sign rule.

conversion_check.description: For valid demonstration labels, compare decoded IK FK against the commanded TCP pose in metres/radians and compare the unchanged gripper scalar; the maximum must be at most 0.005. Rotation 6D projection is exact on encoded labels, while nonunique joints are allowed. IK convergence, residuals, iterations and limit contacts are reported.

cut_relation: Uses every assigned action in all twelve [1120,1500) slices, including incoming [1120,1270) and outgoing [1380,1500) overlap. The implementation changes only coordinates: labels are FK TCP commands expressed in the causal hole frame, not trimmed or relabeled native actions.
